scope.experience: Question answering grounded in a user-selected set of notebook sources
scope.task: Supply two documents, ask for a comparison, and open citations to inspect the supporting passages.
scope.configuration: Standalone source Q&A. NotebookLM was renamed Gemini Notebook in July 2026; no cloud-computer or cross-app operations are assumed.
scope.audience_perspective: A learner or knowledge worker investigating supplied materials

conversational.rationale: Free-form questions and follow-ups are possible, but answers are deliberately scoped by source selection and the notebook's contents.
conversational.uncertainty: Open conversation is bounded by the provided evidence rather than unrestricted knowledge or actions.

specialization.rationale: Source-grounded research and synthesis are a clear specialized workflow, although notebooks can cover many domains.
specialization.uncertainty: Specific knowledge depends on the chosen sources; this does not establish expert-domain accuracy.

autonomy.rationale: The product retrieves relevant material and synthesizes an answer without step-by-step retrieval instructions; the user supplies sources and directs each task.
autonomy.uncertainty: New cloud-computer capabilities are excluded to keep the reference applicable to source Q&A.

accessibility.rationale: A conversational research workflow is approachable for learners and knowledge workers, but collecting and interpreting source material is a meaningful prerequisite.
accessibility.uncertainty: Account access, source formats, language and plan limits vary; there was no direct usability or assistive-technology testing.

explainability.rationale: Direct source quotations and citations that navigate to passages make the output's evidential basis unusually inspectable.
explainability.uncertainty: Short sources may have no individual citation, and citations can still be incomplete; source transparency does not expose reliable internal reasoning.

provenance_notes: AI-assisted documentation review, 2026-10-18; no live product tests. Scope: source-grounded Q&A in Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM), excluding cloud-computer and cross-app workflows. Scores are design estimates. Sources: https://support.google.com/notebooklm/answer/14276569?hl=en and https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/products/gemini-notebook/notebooklm-gemini-notebook/ .
